dataset: A dataset version, with its data card and a content-addressed snapshot, submitted by the data owner and steward.
checks: Admission checks: rights from the ledger, lawful basis, licence, quality, quantity per group, representativeness, bias examination and integrity.
record: The admission record admits, admits with conditions or rejects the version for named pipelines and use cases, signed by the data owner.
policy: A read-time policy denies any read the admission record does not permit for the job's use case and target system.
job: A training, evaluation or retrieval-index job presents its use-case id and target system before it reads a byte.
evidence: Each allowed read is logged and lineage joins the admission record to the run that used it.
denied: A read with no admission for that use is denied and the attempt is recorded.
